description: This file implements a class and functions for matching subgraphs within a computational graph, used in PyTorch's JIT compiler. It includes methods for comparing nodes and values, validating pattern graphs, and finding pattern matches in a target graph.

classes.name: SubgraphMatcher
classes.description: A class providing an API for comparing subgraphs within a computational graph, including methods for matching nodes and values, and verifying pattern validity.

methods.name: matchesSubgraphFromAnchorNode
methods.description: Starts the subgraph matching process from a given anchor node, returning true if the pattern matches.

methods.name: matchValues
methods.description: Compares two values from pattern and target graph for a match based on node, uses, and other attributes.

methods.name: matchNodes
methods.description: Compares two nodes for a match, considering kind, inputs, outputs, attributes, and special cases.

methods.name: matchAttributes
methods.description: Checks if two nodes' attributes match, including regex matching for string attributes.

methods.name: isInput
methods.description: Determines if a value is an input parameter.

methods.name: isOutput
methods.description: Determines if a value is an output of the graph.
